name: CDIF Concept or Term or String
abstract: Shared union shape for a CDIF property that accepts either a controlled-vocabulary value (SKOS concept @id-ref, schema:DefinedTerm, or inline cdif:Concept — the cdifConceptOrTerm union) OR a plain string label. Consolidates 22 previously-inline 'anyOf: [string, cdifConceptOrTerm]' (and 2 'anyOf: [string, DefinedTerm]') sites across cdifCore, cdifDiscovery, cdifInstanceVariable, cdifRepresentedVariable, cdifDataStructureComponent, cdifStatistics, cdifReference, cdifOpenApi, plus schemaorgProperties/agentInRole (roleName) and schemaorgProperties/organization (additionalType items).
